woodcutter-radius.label: Woodcutter Forest Radius
labels: Controls the woodcutter productivity circle. Default: 4. Vanilla maximum: 8.

charcoal-radius.label: Charcoal Kiln Forest Radius
labels: Controls the charcoal kiln productivity circle. Default: 4.5. Vanilla maximum: 9.

required-forest-area.label: Required Free Forest Area
labels: Free area required for full productivity. Default: 40. Vanilla maximum: 80.

Description.English: Adds configurable forest-radius and required-area sliders for Roman and Celtic woodcutters and charcoal kilns. Defaults are approximately half the vanilla values, allowing farms, ornaments and landscaping to be placed closer to forestry buildings. Existing saves are supported.
